3 years, Level 8 Honours (NFQ 8) (assumed — the MH101 course page itself does not state a year count, but every sibling Maynooth BA sharing its first-year subject pool, e.g. MH109/MH111/MH116, is stated as 3 years); 4 years with the optional BA International / Erasmus-Study-Abroad track. CAO code MH101; CAO points 300 (2026 entry). Common-entry degree: 32 subjects timetabled into 6 groups; choose 2, 3 or 4 subjects (max 1 per group) at registration in Year 1, with flexible second-year pathways. Group 1: Geography, German, Law, Mathematics (Pure), Philosophy. Group 2: Business (International), Business (Management), Business (Marketing), Criminology, History, Music (extra 15 credits). Group 3: English, International Development, Mathematical Studies, Mathematics (Pure), Nua-Ghaeilge (extra 15 credits). Group 4: Anthropology, Economics, Finance, Music Technology, Nua-Ghaeilge. Group 5: Computer Science, Music, Spanish. Group 6: Accounting, Chinese Studies, Classical Studies, French, Geography, Mathematical Physics, Media, Film & Cultural Studies, Medieval Celtic Studies, Politics, Psychological Studies, Statistics (each group also offers an optional 15-credit Critical Skills course). Five of this dataset's six core Arts and Humanities departments (Ancient Classics as 'Classical Studies', English, History, Music, Philosophy) are offered as MH101 subjects; Media Studies also appears here as 'Media, Film & Cultural Studies' alongside its own standalone BA (MH109). Several Social Sciences departments (Anthropology, Economics, Law, Criminology, Sociology is not separately listed but Politics/Psychological Studies/Business streams are) are also choosable within MH101, confirming the programme spans beyond the Faculty of Arts and Humanities alone.
